title: [Bug] Azure OpenAI o1-mini not support?
body:
### 📦 Environment

Docker

### 📌 Version

v1.49.12

### 💻 Operating System

Ubuntu

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

connect to azure openai o1-mini model failed with this error, while others model (4o, 4o-mini) could work as expected.
the configuration looks like: `AZURE_MODEL_LIST: gpt-4o->gpt-4o=gpt-4o,gpt-4o-mini->gpt-4o-mini=gpt-4o-mini,o1-mini->o1-mini=o1-mini`

```
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Unsupported value: 'messages[0].role' does not support 'system' with this model.",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": "messages[0].role",
    "code": "unsupported_value"
  },
  "endpoint": "https://***.openai.azure.com/",
  "provider": "azure"
}
```

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

_No response_

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

_No response_

Fix https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6201

将`system` role切换成`user` role或者`developer` role。

#### 📝 补充信息 | Additional Information

当使用 Azure OpenAI 的 O-series 模型（如 o1, o1-mini 等）时，如果设定了 system prompt 会导致以下错误：

```
"error": {
  "message": "Unsupported value: 'messages[0].role' does not support 'system' with this model.",
  "type": "invalid_request_error",
  "param": "messages[0].role",
  "code": "unsupported_value"
}
```

- close #6281
- close #5885

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue as it involves an LLM provider (Azure OpenAI) and reports an error related to an unsupported model (`o1-mini`) and its configuration, which falls under the "Unsupported models" sub-category of "Incompatibility with LLM providers".
